newsitem.title: POLAND: Creditanstalt to expand in Poland.
newsitem.headline: Creditanstalt to expand in Poland.

text.p: The Polish unit of Austria's bank Creditanstalt-Bankverein wants to double the number of its branches in Poland to 15 and offer new products, an official from the bank's said on Thursday.

"We plan to open a total of 15 branches in Poland's big cities," PAP news agency quoted Jacek Moscicki, the Polish unit's president, as saying during the opening ceremony of the bank's seventh branch, in the south-western city of Wroclaw.
"We also want to add new products each year to services we provide," Creditanstalt's managing director Alarch Fenyves told PAP.
Creditanstalt launched its Polish subsidiary in 1991. PAP said the bank's share capital was 90 million zlotys.
